_: The Phase 8b contract in machine-readable form: for every route, the keys the pages actually read. Derived from site/public/assets/*.js by grepping each page's property accesses. tests/api/test_contract.py checks the real routers against it; site/mock/check.mjs checks the mock. Both read THIS file, so the two halves cannot drift apart. shape: object | list | map. keys = required on the object, or on every row of a list. rows = {field: [keys required on every row of that list-valued field]}. nested = {field: [keys required on that object-valued field]}.

settings._: The registry IS the truth (black_bloc/settings_store.py). This block is the one table both halves read: tests/api/test_contract.py asserts it equals CORE_KEYS / KEY_MIN / KEY_MAX, and site/mock/check.mjs asserts the mock's own /api/settings matches it. A bound invented in the mock, or one added to the registry and not mirrored, fails one half or the other by name.

routes._: THE one home for money (owner ask, 2026-09-01). `models` is the llm_ledger grouped by provider, model and tier — both fixtures seed a paid row and a free one, so an empty list here means the ledger query broke rather than that nothing was spent. `secrets` is derived from config.py's own fields and carries NAMES and set/unset only.
